root_cause: Composio held four ACTIVE connected-account credentials that all resolved to the same Instagram provider user id 28328860976766075.
The publisher treated credential count as account identity count and therefore emitted COMPOSIO_INSTAGRAM_CONNECTION_AMBIGUOUS even though there was only one provider identity.
The identity preflight reused a legacy proxy URL expression that stripped '/api/v3' from an already-v3.1 base, producing invalid backend.composio.dev.1 URLs.
prevention: When multiple Instagram connected-account credentials are active, resolve /me for each credential and deduplicate by provider user id before deciding ambiguity.
Multiple credentials for one provider user id are one publishing identity and may be reduced deterministically to one credential.
Multiple distinct provider user ids remain fail-closed as genuine account ambiguity.
Never choose a credential merely because it is first in discovery order.
Use COMPOSIO_BASE + '/tools/execute/proxy' directly when COMPOSIO_BASE is already https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3.1; never derive the proxy host by substring replacement.
